inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic NSCLC (Stage IV).
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic NSCLC (Stage IV).

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Documented progression after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy combined with anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Documented progression after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy combined with anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: At least one measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: At least one measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: AST and ALT ≤ 2.5 x ULN (≤ 5 x ULN if liver metastases)
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: AST and ALT ≤ 2.5 x ULN (≤ 5 x ULN if liver metastases)

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Women of childbearing potential must have a negative pregnancy test prior to treatment initiation.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Women of childbearing potential must have a negative pregnancy test prior to treatment initiation.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Signed informed consent prior to any study-specific procedure.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Signed informed consent prior to any study-specific procedure.

exclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Known EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 genomic alterations with available approved targeted therapy.
exclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Known EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 genomic alterations with available approved targeted therapy.

exclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppressive therapy.
exclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppressive therapy.

exclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Other active invasive malignancy within 3 years (except adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer or carcinoma in situ).
exclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Other active invasive malignancy within 3 years (except adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer or carcinoma in situ).
